verdict.rationale: Qdrant's own multitenancy guide documents keeping all tenants in a single collection and isolating them with one of three approaches, including partition by payload. That approach is described as efficient for a large number of small, similarly-sized tenants, which covers the cheap, many-tenant isolation part of the story. The pack does not show documented limits such as maximum tenants or collections, or per-tenant quotas, and the other two approaches are not detailed. Missing for 10: documented tenant/collection count limits, details of the other two isolation approaches, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant scale.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can isolate many tenants cheaply using namespaces, partitions, or per-tenant collections with documented limits

citations.quote: keep all tenants in a single collection and use one of these three approaches to isolate them
Partition by payload filters points by a payload field that identifies the tenant. This is efficient for a large number of small, similarly-sized tenants.
